|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[One Bright Spot (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The image here is the Virtual Block 6.1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-46-One_Bright_Spot.png]]), which shows this text; the Master List slip and the Players Committee card image show the PC-E1 text (see [[One Bright Spot (Errata)]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet, first copy (official text as of 4 September 2009; slip [[:File:VB6-46-One_Bright_Spot.png]])<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref>: “If Galen was just lost and Black Leader is on table (or vice versa), place the just-lost character on your Used Pile instead. OR If Black Leader is participating in a battle, you may lose Galen from hand to satisfy all battle damage and attrition against you.” The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) showed the same text.<ref name="cl-1261_45-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[One Bright Spot (Errata)]]): Black Leader becomes Juno Eclipse (the persona was renamed) and “you may lose” becomes “may lose”: “If Galen was just lost and Juno Eclipse is on table (or vice versa), place the just-lost character on your Used Pile instead. OR If Juno Eclipse is participating in a battle, may lose Galen from hand to satisfy all battle damage and attrition against you.” Printed in the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) (slip [[:File:VL-history-1261-45-front-master.png]])<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=38, page 38. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=38 Internet Archive]</ref>; the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-onebrightspot-pre.gif]]) prints the same text. The new name follows the persona-name change “Black Leader ---> Juno Eclipse”, effective 29 January 2013 (“in effect immediately” in the [[Players Committee]]'s announcement of that day).<ref name="persona2013">[https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 New Persona Changes], [[Players Committee]], 29 January 2013. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive].</ref>
